annotations.title: Mark a fix done and verify it

description: Records that the person finished a fix and checks it at once where one check can tell (the page has the schema or the sentence, the Wikidata item has the statements, the profile is live): verified, not done yet with what is missing, or done and waiting for the next scan. Use this when the person says a fix is live, with its link in url. Do not use for a fix that is not live yet. Side effects: fetches that one public page; changes the account's own record.

gap_id.description: The gap id from get_gaps. Example: "5f0c2a9e-7b1d-4c3e-9a8f-2d6b4e1c7a90"

url.description: The page or profile where the fix is live. Example: "https://northwind.example/about"

name: mark_fix_done
